description: This PHP source file defines the API endpoint class 'ReviewKpiAPI' within the OrangeHRM performance module. It provides functionality to list KPIs associated with a specific performance review, including request validation, pagination, and sorting. The class uses traits for performance review services and user role management, and it primarily implements the 'getAll' method for retrieving KPI data.
